faqs.question: How does admission to MU Chittorgarh work?
faqs.answer: Admission to agriculture programmes at Mewar University, Chittorgarh is conducted through Rajasthan JET / CUET (UG) / MUEE, alongside direct university merit counselling for eligible 10+2 Agriculture/Science candidates. Both Rajasthan JET state counselling seats and university-level seats require verification of Class XII subject combinations (PCB, PCM, PCA or Agriculture) and original academic certificates at reporting. Check Rajasthan JET or University Application Window: Register through the official Mewar University, Chittorgarh admissions portal (https://www.mewaruniversity.org/pages/Agriculture_and_Veterinary_Science.aspx) or select the institution during Rajasthan JET / Pre-PG choice filling. Submit Academic & Entrance Score Details: Provide Class X and XII mark sheets (or B.Sc. Agriculture transcript for PG), JET/CUET/University entrance scorecard and category certificate. Document Verification & Tuition Fee Confirmation: Verify original documents on campus at Chittorgarh and obtain the itemised semester/annual fee receipt including hostel and examination heads.

faqs.answer: Published phone: 01471-294442. Published email: admission@mewaruniversity.org. Official admissions: https://www.mewaruniversity.org/pages/Agriculture_and_Veterinary_Science.aspx

faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) in adopted villages during the final year. faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Agronomy & Instructional Crop Farm: Field demonstration plots at Chittorgarh for kharif and rabi crop trials, seed bed preparation, weed management and micro-irrigation exercises. Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry Lab: Equipped for soil pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, macronutrient (N-P-K) and micronutrient testing. Horticulture, Polyhouse & Orchard Unit: Protected cultivation polyhouse/shade-net house, fruit orchard nursery and post-harvest handling practical space. Plant Pathology, Entomology & Genetics Labs: Compound and stereo microscopy, insect rearing cages, disease specimen collection and seed purity testing equipment. Student Hostels, Library & Transport: Separate boys and girls residential hostels at Chittorgarh, agricultural library journals, mess and city bus connectivity.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for MU Chittorgarh?

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: Mewar University, Chittorgarh offers merit-based tuition scholarships based on Class XII / qualifying examination marks or JET rank, alongside Rajasthan government post-matric scholarships (SJMS / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag) for eligible SC, ST, OBC, MBC and EBC students. University Entrance & Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship (2026-27): Tuition fee waiver slabs (10% to 50% in first year) for applicants scoring 75%+ to 90%+ in 10+2 or high rank in Rajasthan JET / CUET; continuation requires maintaining minimum SGPA and 75% attendance. Rajasthan State Post-Matric & Girl Child Agriculture Incentive: Eligible Rajasthan domicile students can apply on the Rajasthan SSO Scholarship Portal; girl students in agriculture may also check state Rajshree / Agriculture Department incentive schemes.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for MU Chittorgarh?
faqs.answer: The placement and training cell at Mewar University, Chittorgarh coordinates final-year agribusiness agro-industrial attachments, KVK internships and preparation for Rajasthan Agriculture Supervisor, AAO, Pre-PG, ICAR JRF and IBPS AFO competitive examinations. Graduates pursue roles in seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, micro-irrigation, agri-fintech, warehousing and rural banking sectors, as well as M.Sc. Agriculture through Rajasthan Pre-PG and CUET-PG.
